title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.10
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.10 is now available.
Update retries now refresh the latest trusted installer URL and SHA-256 metadata instead of reusing stale values.
Improved update notice cache-busting for rapid metadata corrections.
Preserved mandatory SHA-256 verification with clearer checksum mismatch diagnostics.
Click Update Now below to securely download, verify, and install the new build.
